reuse.why: Adds the rule to the existing shouldFillCategory selection used by every month-wide action and parses the tag with the existing extractTagsFromText from #shared/tags.

duplication.why: The rule itself exists once; only the notes LEFT JOIN is added to both existing category queries (getBudgetData and getAllCategoriesWithGroupHidden), following how group_hidden is already fetched in both.

placement.why: The fixed-group check sits in the shared category-selection definition in budget/actions.ts, and the data is fetched in the existing query helpers.

scope.why: Only the query columns, the selection rule, the row types and a focused test.

maintainability.why: Easy to own; the only friction is that the two queries must keep their group-notes joins in sync, and the updated doc comment is left badly wrapped.

disguised_duplication.where: Only the group-notes join is repeated, openly, in the two existing queries.

one_place.where: isFixedGroup is checked inside shouldFillCategory in server/budget/actions.ts, which copyPreviousMonth, setZero and the average actions all use.
